title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face by creating a closed loop with four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.01, 0.0). The second line begins at (0.01, 0.0) and ends at (0.01, 0.01). The third line starts at (0.01, 0.01) and ends at (0.0, 0.01). The fourth line completes the loop from (0.0, 0.01) back to the origin. Scale this sketch by a factor of 0.01. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using Euler angles of zero and translating it with a vector of zero. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a new solid body. This forms a cylindrical base with a small protrusion at the top, measuring 0.01 units in length and width, and 0.75 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.01, 0).lineTo(0.01, 0.01).lineTo(0, 0.01).close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylindrical object
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Create a small protrusion at the top of the cylinder
protrusion = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.005, 0.005).circle(0.005).extrude(0.01)

# Combine the cylinder and the protrusion
r = cylinder.union(protrusion.translate((0, 0, 0.75)))

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.01, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.01, 0.01) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.01) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a cylinder
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Create a new workplane at the top of the cylinder
r = r.faces(">Z").workplane()

# Create a sketch on the top face
r = r.moveTo(0.005, 0.005) \
     .circle(0.005)

# Extrude the sketch to create a small protrusion
r = r.extrude(0.01)

# Final model
r = r.combine()  # Combine all parts into a single solid

# Extrude the circle to create a cylinder

# Create a circle with the specified center and radius

# Extrude the circle to create a small protrusion
